name: @yingge/drsg
stderr:
dr-strange graph database CLI

Usage: drsg [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init         Bootstrap this repository for agent MCP access: digest it, spawn `serve watch` detached in the background, and write the connection details to `.mcp.json`
  token        Print the bearer token a previous `init` recorded, masked
  plane        Plane lifecycle
  import       Import JSONL nodes/edges into a plane
  export       Export a plane as JSONL
  get          Fetch one node by id or `@external-key`
  query        Run a serialized query plan (JSON)
  cypher       Run a query in the openCypher-subset language (compiled to a plan)
  queries      The Cypher queries that have run, newest first — id, when, plane and text. (`drsg history` is the other one: a repository's commits.)
  context      One symbol's whole neighborhood in one call: definition, signature, doc, fields, callers with call sites, callees, containment and every other edge, plus what holds it or it holds by span where no edge relates them — the primary agent verb. Fuzzy names allowed; ambiguity returns candidates
  search       Semantic lookup when no identifier is known: embeds the query, runs cosine top-k over the plane's `embedding` vectors, expands the best hit. Requires the plane to be vectorized
  describe     One symbol's content as `prop: value` lines (vectors elided) — the lightweight node-only view; `context` adds the edges and the spans
  trace        How one symbol reaches another: the shortest recorded CALLS path, one hop per line; the reverse direction is tried and said when the forward holds nothing
  impact       Blast radius: everything reaching this symbol through incoming structural edges, grouped by distance with exact counts
  attach       Record a plane this one may ask — a plane on this instance, or one served by another drsg
  mount        Serve the planes of another database on a running drsg, now
  unmount      Stop serving a mounted database. An absent name is reported, not an error; nothing is deleted
  mounts       What a running drsg serves: each mounted database with its directory and planes, and every plane with the source tree it records
  detach       Forget an attachment. An absent name is reported, not an error
  attachments  What a plane attaches, and whether each is there to be asked
  wire         What serves an HTTP path, and what asks for it — matched across every language in the plane, computed now and never stored
  snippet      Source text: a symbol read to its end, or a range of a file
  grep         Text search over the tree a plane was parsed from — each hit names the symbol it falls inside, so the next call is `context` or `snippet` on that key rather than opening the file
  traverse     Walk edges from one node: the neighbours a hop (or several) away
  fathom       Read one region closely: what is within a few hops of this symbol, by label and edge type, with the hubs that hold it together
  history      A repository's history at a glance: where HEAD is, what the branches and tags point at, what was rebased, and the newest commits. Reads the `_git` plane a digest of a git checkout writes — naming the code plane finds it. Name a symbol or a path for the commits that changed it
  deployed     What commit a running thing was built from, and what runs a commit. Joins the `_ops` plane — the workloads, images and infrastructure a digest of manifests records — to the `_git` plane beside it, through the revision an image's tag carries
  recall       Code as it was at a git revision: a file, a range, a directory or a symbol read at `--at`; a search of that tree (`--pattern`); or what changed since an older revision (`--vs`)
  catalog      Print the soft-schema catalog (a plane's, or the whole database's)
  algo         Graph algorithms over a plane (ROADMAP §1): read-only, transient results
  hybrid       Hybrid retrieval (ROADMAP §2): fuse vector + keyword + graph-proximity
  index        Vector index management
  stats        Summary counts across the database
  check        Integrity check: scan every plane, report readability
